# VAG Scope

> VAG Scope is an Android app by mtmagicapps that reads VW, Audi, Seat and Škoda cars through a Bluetooth ELM327 adapter and checks their mileage against the control units.

- Cars: Volkswagen, Audi, Seat and Škoda using TP 2.0 (about 2004–2010) or UDS on 11-bit CAN ids (about 2012 and later); mixed cars work unit by unit. Not supported: cars with 29-bit diagnostic ids only (MEB electric cars such as the ID. models, and MQB evo cars such as the Golf 8 generation).
- Adapter: any Bluetooth ELM327 adapter (Classic or BLE on Android, BLE only on iPhone). Tested with a vLinker MC+.
- Features: mileage check (odometer against the distance stored in each control unit), VIN check, control-unit scan, fault codes with freeze frames, live data, dashboards (also on Android Auto), coding, long coding, adaptation, basic settings with guided functions, output tests, community procedures, demo cars.
- Results are indicative: the app never says a car is genuine or that its mileage is correct.
- Privacy: no network permission, no account, no advertising, no analytics.
- Platforms: Android 9 or later. An iPhone version with Apple CarPlay is planned.
- Languages: English and French.
- Price: one payment on Google Play (€9.99 in the euro zone), no subscription, no in-app purchase.
- Publisher: mtmagicapps, published by DS ECOM (France). Not affiliated with Volkswagen AG, Audi AG, SEAT, S.A. or ŠKODA AUTO a.s.

- [mtmagicapps – small apps, made with care](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/): mtmagicapps is an independent software editor. Our first app, VAG Scope, turns your phone into a diagnostic tool for Volkswagen, Audi, Seat and Škoda cars.
- [Mileage check and OBD app for VW, Audi, Seat, Škoda | VAG Scope](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/): Check a used VW, Audi, Seat or Škoda before you buy: VAG Scope compares the odometer with the control units, checks the VIN and reads fault codes.
- [Check the car yourself | VAG Scope](https://mtmagicapps.github.io/vag-scope/check/): Someone shared a VAG Scope report with you? Run the same mileage and VIN check on the car yourself, with your phone and a Bluetooth ELM327 adapter.
